enemies.name: Marrow-Umbilical Twin
enemies.notes: Forgotten irrigation in the Seed Assembly side quest (U2 clay canvas, 12 fps; filed under U9 with the other side-quest and post-game enemies). Heals its partner 2 plates per 8 s unless severed with a LINE_PIERCE (Spore Rail 14.0). Break: freezes mid-swing; its amber spill cures 1 Grief-Resonance stack. The quest asks you to break-lock both and pour three waters at once through the gramophone horn (see boss cassia_forge_tendril).

enemies.name: Dust Mote Cluster — Memory of Stirring
enemies.notes: Golden Light Debt Echo (Ending 1, Phase 1: nine of them at Lv 80 in the rebuilt U0 Atrium, watercolour 60 fps).

enemies.name: Porcelain Shardling — Crono's Denial
enemies.notes: Golden Light Debt Echo; mimics Crono's 60% sprites (uses the 60-integrity Crono state sheet).

enemies.name: Ashen Spoon — Sera's First Slip
enemies.notes: Golden Light Debt Echo. 10 keyed plates (order break): the bible gives materials [ICE][DARK] and weaknesses [FIRE][SWORD][TACHYON] with no explicit keys, so per 5.6 the plates key to the weaknesses in order; the 4/3/3 split of the 10 plates is an inference. The first time it is damaged, Crono must pay 5% max-HP ceiling (battle strain); after that, never again. With Light >= 90 its Break leaves a light puddle that heals 15% and thaws Ruin.

enemies.name: Ledger Wisp
enemies.notes: Post-game Codex Auditor: a flat sheet listing one of your flag choices. Regret Tick: +5% Camp Strain to Crono each turn the camera lingers on it. Break: folds into a gold butterfly showing the correct shave arithmetic.

enemies.name: Arris Echo (Incinerated variant)
enemies.notes: Post-game Codex Auditor for the Arris_Dome flag (Incinerated route). Its hymn is the shattering scream from the Incinerated route; Grief-Resonance in a 6 m ring. A Sleeping-route player meets arris_echo_sleeping instead.

enemies.name: Arris Echo (Sleeping variant)
enemies.notes: Post-game Codex Auditor for the Arris_Dome=Sleeping route: same plates as the Incinerated variant, weak [SOUND][ASTRAL], and it sleeps when Broken (a Broken Sleeping Echo counts as spared).
